text:
Ana (CSM): Quick heads-up — Covenant Health QBR scheduled for Tue 3/31. We need a short token econ snapshot, 30d burn, 90d forecast, and any onboarding gaps that could affect renewal. Who can own numbers and 1-3 cost mitigations?

Jules (FinOps): I can take numbers. Need confirmation of what to include in forecast assumptions (growth, new features). Also: do we pull committed credits vs usage?

Ravi (Solutions Eng): I'll run a quick prompt/build eval for waste (excessive max_tokens, unbounded system prompts). Quick wins: enable prefix KV caching, lower default max_tokens to 512 for non-chat routes, and add per-route rate limits.

CostBot (bot): Alert: Covenant Health crossed 78% of committed credits last 7d — see https://console.redwood/cust/CovenantHealth/usage

Jules (FinOps): Thanks. I'll pull last 30d burn & committed vs actual. Propose forecast assumptions: +15% MoM usage baseline, 5% feature spike buffer. Any objections?

Marta (AE): Please call out onboarding flows that generate long completions (reports export). Customer asked for full transcript history retention — that's a big token sink.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Quick config snippet I tested that reduces tokens by ~20% for report-generators:
```
# Set per-route defaults
max_tokens: 512
stream: true
cache_prefix: true
quantization_profile: 4bit
```
Also recommend a small eval: rerun top 1000 requests with lower max_tokens to measure quality delta.

Ana (CSM): Owners: Jules -> numbers, Ravi -> mitigation experiments, Marta -> customer context + ask list. I'll consolidate into the QBR deck (slide slot 3). Please drop links to the two artefacts by EOD Fri.

Jules (FinOps): Will post dataset and forecast doc by 5pm Fri. tagging @ana @ravi @marta

Ana (CSM): :thumbsup: Appreciated — I'll send calendar invite for pre-QBR dry run Mon.
